snippet.title: The Cult-Classic Rally That Broke Emulation Returns with 3 Arcade Gems! | Gaelco Sports Collection
snippet.description:
The golden age of 90s coin-op racing and extreme sports is back! Gaelco Sports Collection brings 5 blistering Spanish arcade hits to modern consoles and PC on January 21, 2027.

Before rally games became hyper-realistic sims, the legendary Spanish studio Gaelco S.A. owned the arcade floors with World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, delivering pure isometric drifting perfection, strict 60-second timers, and razor-sharp reflexes that ate quarters by the handful.

Now, the entire sports duology and three iconic coin-op companions are fully preserved for the modern era:

- World Rally Championship (1993) – The isometric arcade racing titan that sold over 23,000 units across Europe.
- World Rally 2: Twin Racing (1995) – Expanded rally circuits, selectable rally legends, and head-to-head ghost car rivalries.
- Snowboard Championship (1997) – High-speed alpine downhill carving with slalom gates and full 360° loops.
- Touch and Go (1995) – Lightning-fast 2v2 beach volleyball packed with high-stakes sudden-death match points.
- Squash (1992) – Gaelco’s frenetic, reflex-heavy indoor racquet challenge.

MODERN FEATURES:
• Instant Save States to master every hairpin turn
• Authentic CRT screen filters replicating vintage arcade monitors
• Local multiplayer face-offs
• Museum gallery packed with original manuals and historical arcade art

GET READY & WISHLIST:
Gaelco Sports Collection for Steam, Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch: 
https://www.qubytegames.store/allgames/gaelco-sports-collection
